subject: [PATCH v3 2/2] memcg: don't go through the lruvec for folio and kmem lruvec stat updates

2026-10-23.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the update of per-memcg LRU statistics by bypassing the lruvec lookup and instead passing the memcg and node directly to mod_memcg_node_state(). This reduces contention on a shared cacheline, improving throughput in certain workloads. The change is made in the mm/memcontrol.c file and affects the reparent_memcg_lruvec_state_local() function. The patch was submitted by Joanne Koong and has been acknowledged by Shakeel Butt.

2026-10-26.patch_summary: This patch optimizes memory cgroup (memcg) statistics updates by bypassing the lruvec data structure for folio and kmem lruvec stat updates. It directly passes the memcg and node to the mod_memcg_node_state function, reducing contention with other threads that access the lru_lock holder. This change improves throughput in certain scenarios, such as on a 2-socket Skylake system with multiple threads accessing shared memory.
